name: airship-restaurant
description: A Windows desktop companion idle game built with Electron, Phaser, React and TypeScript.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/contracts && npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/core && npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/content && npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/persistence && npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/test-support
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @airship-restaurant/desktop
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
